title: claudex pull assignment, version 1
description: The complete authoritative assignment returned by pull: what this session must do this turn, including the exact schema its submission must satisfy. Phase/role-specific — a lead edit phase carries a mutable worktree; every other phase carries an immutable evidence root.

protocol_version.description: The protocol major version; always 1 for this schema.

message_type.description: Discriminates this message from other protocol messages.

run_id.description: The run this assignment belongs to.

session_id.description: The session this assignment is addressed to.

turn_id.description: The turn the preceding transition issued; pull never mints this.

role.description: Which role must act this turn.

phase.description: The phase whose work this assignment covers.

expected_state_revision.description: The run-state revision a submit for this turn must compare-and-swap against.

binding_guidance.description: Human decisions that remain binding for the rest of the run.

artifact_message_type.description: The message type a submit for this turn must be.

artifact_schema_json.description: The exact embedded schema bytes a submit must satisfy, so pull is a complete provider instruction.

artifact_schema_sha256.description: Lower-hex sha256 over artifact_schema_json, binding it to the registry entry.

worktree.description: The mutable worktree path, present only for a lead edit phase (IMPLEMENT_STEP/FIX); null otherwise.

evidence.description: The immutable, hash-bound evidence root a read-only phase reviews from; null for a lead edit phase.

manifest_rel_path.description: Canonical run-relative path of the evidence manifest.

root_digest.description: Lower-hex sha256 binding the evidence content.
